root.name: Sicilian Defense: Four Knights Variation
root.moves: 1. e4 c5 2. Nf3 e6 3. d4 cxd4 4. Nxd4 Nf6 5. Nc3 Nc6

overview: This is the Taimanov or Four Knights Sicilian, reached after both sides develop two knights. White chooses between 6.Nxc6 bxc6 7.e5 Nd5 8.Ne4 Qc7, giving Black doubled c-pawns for activity, 6.Ndb5 Bb4 with sharp central play, and quieter 6.Be3 or 6.Bg5. Black aims for ...d5 or ...Bb4 counterplay and ...Qc7; White for e5 space and kingside pieces.

white_ideas.idea: 6.Nxc6 bxc6 7.e5 Nd5 8.Ne4 Qc7 9.f4, gaining space on the kingside.
6.Ndb5 Bb4 7.a3 Bxc3+ 8.Nxc3 d5, using the bishop pair and development lead.

black_ideas.idea: Doubled c-pawns for central control and the open b-file, then ...Qc7 and ...Bb7.
...Bb4 pin and ...d5 to hit the centre quickly.

typical_structures.structure: Black doubled c-pawns (c6/c5) after Nxc6 bxc6.

character.notes: Main lines 6.Nxc6 and 6.Ndb5 lead to tactical, unbalanced positions where both sides take risks.

soundness.notes: Sound; played at the top for decades.

structure.notes: Sicilian asymmetry with a half-open c-file or b-file.

level.notes: Needs concrete theory in the Ndb5 lines, but most lines are Intermediate; the Taimanov is not Advanced.

sublines_that_differ.name: Exchange
sublines_that_differ.how: Black accepts doubled c-pawns for central play.

sublines_that_differ.name: 6.Ndb5
sublines_that_differ.how: Sharper, with a d6 hole and tactical play.

character.reason: Main lines 6.Nxc6 and 6.Ndb5 are tactical and double-edged.

structure.reason: Sicilian asymmetry with a half-open file.

level.reason: Needs some memory and Sicilian understanding but is not Advanced.

plans.reason: Black accepts doubled pawns; White gains space with e5.
